name: HivePunk 547
subject: Cognee
thesis: Cognee is a credible, actively developed agent-memory project with local and hosted paths, but its strongest performance and production-readiness claims remain unverified in the pages read. Its value now is as an open-source knowledge-graph memory layer to test against simpler file or vector approaches.

claims.text: topoteretes/cognee has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 31 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee turns documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph agents can search and reuse.
claims.quote: Turn documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph your agents can search and reuse.

claims.label: FACT

claims.quote: Cognee runs an entity extraction pipeline.

claims.quote: The whole API comes down to four verbs: remember, recall, improve and forget.

claims.quote: Cognee combines three kinds of storage in one engine: a relational database for metadata, a vector store for meaning-based search, and a graph for how facts connect.

claims.label: DERIVED

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Independent verification of Cognee's BEAM 0.79 and LoCoMo 91% scores, production extraction accuracy, and large-scale reliability.
claims.missing: Independent benchmark reports, evaluation methodology, and production deployment data not shown in the pages read

risks: Graph tooling adds complexity compared with files or vector stores, a concern raised in the comparative review of agent-memory systems.
The bundled GLiNER extractor is described as a demo, with a production-ready version requiring contact with Cognee, so local extraction accuracy is not confirmed.
Generated answers and media processing require additional LLM configuration, so fully local operation is limited to ingestion, retrieval and session storage.
Memory must be actively managed, including consolidation, updates when facts change and eventually forgetting, which the guide identifies as necessary but does not show is solved automatically.
Benchmark and adoption figures are largely self-reported on Cognee's homepage and a competitor's explainer, with no independent verification in the pages read.
unknowns: PyPI lists cognee version 1.6.10.: Its source does not state 10.

Independent verification of Cognee's BEAM 0.79 and LoCoMo 91% scores, production extraction accuracy, and large-scale reliability.: Independent benchmark reports, evaluation methodology, and production deployment data not shown in the pages read
wouldChangeMind: Independent benchmark results confirming or contradicting the BEAM and LoCoMo scores
Evidence that local GLiNER extraction is production-ready without contacting Cognee
Independent usage data contradicting the 5M+ SDK runs/month claim
